posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

I understand the NL language
Translate this if you don't

Jump to the sources read and work

Sources:

https://jackalsyn.com/posts/php-up-2026.html

https://sansec.io/research/php2shell

https://tweakers.net/

Because CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 sit in PHP itself, every app on a vulnerable PHP version is exposed, no matter what runs on top.

That’s why we’re building detection in our Network Scanner + an exploit module in Sniper as you’re reading this. Stay tuned for the launch announcement!

What to do now:

Inventory every PHP install, including control panels, vendor appliances, and Windows software that bundles its own php-cgi.exe
Patch as soon as PHP’s release is out, then restart PHP-FPM or your web server
On PHP 8.1 or older? No fix is coming. Upgrade, or take those systems off the internet
Alert on PHP processes spawning shells, interpreters, or download tools

posts.content:
🔧 Dočasně vypínáme podporu přes FreeScout (helpdesk.oscloud.cz) kvůli kritické chybě v PHP. Znovu ji zapneme po aplikování opravy.

⚠️ Kritická zranitelnost v PHP, co to znamená pro OSCloud

PHP tým oznámil dvě kritické chyby (CVE-2026-109618 a CVE-2026-109619, obě CVSS 9.2). Mohou umožnit spuštění cizího kódu na serveru bez přihlášení. Oprava vychází dnes v 16:00 SEČ/CEST. Podle hlášení bezpečnostních firem už probíhají první útoky.

Kterých služeb se to týká:
• Nextcloud, WordPress, Pixelfed, FreeScout, a další aplikace postavené na PHP
• LAMP weby zákazníků (Apache + PHP), včetně těch, kde zatím běží jen úvodní stránka

Kterých ne:
• Mastodon, Matrix, PeerTube, Gitea (PHP nepoužívají)
• Weby a úložiště na statických souborech (Surfer)

Co děláme:
• FreeScout jsme vypnuli
• Další PHP aplikace a LAMP weby budeme vypínat postupně a vždy o tom budeme informovat zde. Počítejte s tím, že dočasně vypneme i Nextcloud, a to do vydání a nasazení opravy
• Jakmile budou dostupné opravené verze aplikací, nasadíme je co nejdřív
• Před vypnutím a updaty děláme zálohy

Co to znamená pro vás:
• Podpora přes FreeScout je do opravy nedostupná
• Nextcloud, LAMP weby a další PHP služby mohou být dnes nedostupné
• Pokud by se při updatu něco pokazilo, vracíme se ze zálohy maximálně 12 hodin zpět

Opravu nelze řešit pluginy ani updatem WordPressu, musí přijít nové PHP v rámci aktualizace aplikace. Pokud provozujete vlastní PHP web mimo OSCloud, aktualizujte PHP hned, jak vyjde oprava.

Děkujeme za trpělivost. Stav budeme průběžně aktualizovat v tomto vlákně.

#OSCloud #PHP #Bezpečnost

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

Translate this if you don't

Jump to the sources read and work

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

posts.content:
🔧 Dočasně vypínáme podporu přes FreeScout (helpdesk.oscloud.cz) kvůli kritické chybě v PHP. Znovu ji zapneme po aplikování opravy.

⚠️ Kritická zranitelnost v PHP, co to znamená pro OSCloud

PHP tým oznámil dvě kritické chyby (CVE-2026-109618 a CVE-2026-109619, obě CVSS 9.2). Mohou umožnit spuštění cizího kódu na serveru bez přihlášení. Oprava vychází dnes v 16:00 SEČ/CEST. Podle hlášení bezpečnostních firem už probíhají první útoky.

Kterých služeb se to týká:
• Nextcloud, WordPress, Pixelfed, FreeScout, a další aplikace postavené na PHP
• LAMP weby zákazníků (Apache + PHP), včetně těch, kde zatím běží jen úvodní stránka

Kterých ne:
• Mastodon, Matrix, PeerTube, Gitea (PHP nepoužívají)
• Weby a úložiště na statických souborech (Surfer)

Co děláme:
• FreeScout jsme vypnuli
• Další PHP aplikace a LAMP weby budeme vypínat postupně a vždy o tom budeme informovat zde. Počítejte s tím, že dočasně vypneme i Nextcloud, a to do vydání a nasazení opravy
• Jakmile budou dostupné opravené verze aplikací, nasadíme je co nejdřív
• Před vypnutím a updaty děláme zálohy

Co to znamená pro vás:
• Podpora přes FreeScout je do opravy nedostupná
• Nextcloud, LAMP weby a další PHP služby mohou být dnes nedostupné
• Pokud by se při updatu něco pokazilo, vracíme se ze zálohy maximálně 12 hodin zpět

Opravu nelze řešit pluginy ani updatem WordPressu, musí přijít nové PHP v rámci aktualizace aplikace. Pokud provozujete vlastní PHP web mimo OSCloud, aktualizujte PHP hned, jak vyjde oprava.

Děkujeme za trpělivost. Stav budeme průběžně aktualizovat v tomto vlákně.

#OSCloud #PHP #Bezpečnost

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
PHP InfoSec

Wise system administrators who have caught wind of this bug have taken measures already

It hasn't been patched yet but you can mitigate exposure of your systems.
Better yet, do what is written on tweakers.net

Quotes:

Make your store read-only or take it offline

If you can afford to take a PHP server offline for a day, do so. PHP core developer Gina Peter Banyard calls that the most sensible option. Several Dutch sites went offline as a precaution on October 21: tech site Tweakers, the House of Representatives (Tweede Kamer), the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) and security news site Security.NL.

Stop PHP-FPM and have your web server show a static maintenance page. The maintenance modes built into Magento and WordPress do not help: PHP still parses each request before the application checks for the maintenance flag.

If you cannot go offline, make the store read-only. Have your web server reject every request method other than GET and HEAD, for example in nginx:

if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|HEAD)$) {
return 503;
}

Quote:

Websites overnemen

De twee kritieke kwetsbaarheden in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 en CVE-2026-109619) hebben een score van 9,2 op de CVSS v4.0-schaal, die tot 10 gaat. Dat hoge cijfer is gebaseerd op de ernst van een kwetsbaarheid en op hoe makkelijk aanvallers die kunnen misbruiken. De kwetsbaarheden zouden al sinds versie 5.4.0 in PHP zitten, die in maart 2012 uitkwam. Aanvallers kunnen door de kwetsbaarheden eigen webpagina's publiceren. Daardoor kunnen zij mogelijk malware verspreiden. Daarnaast zou de zogeheten PHP2Shell-exploit het mogelijk maken om eigen code uit te voeren op kwetsbare servers.

Volgens verschillende beveiligingsadviezen kan het helpen om session.upload_progress.enabled uit te schakelen. Een bijbehorende tijdelijke oplossing zou zijn om session.use_strict_mode in te schakelen. Beveiligingsexpert Kevin Beaumont meldt dat de Linux-kernelbeveiligingsmodule AppArmor of SELinux ook bescherming biedt tegen misbruik van deze grote PHP-kwetsbaarheden.

posts.content:
@pulsar Thanks!

TL;DR: Details of two critical holes in PHP leaked before a fix was ready. They’re in how PHP handles file uploads and could let attackers run their own code on your server. Possibly affects PHP 5 through 8. Fixes are due today at 14:00 UTC, and attacks are expected within minutes of release.

https://www.vincentschmalbach.com/cve-2026-109618-and-cve-2026-109619-what-you-should-do-now/

The bug sits below WordPress or Laravel, so having no upload form doesn’t protect you, and nor do security plugins or maintenance mode.

Until the patch: list every server running PHP, including old staging sites. Switch off PHP’s upload-progress setting, and get your web server to refuse upload-style requests before they reach PHP. That breaks uploads for a few hours, which is the trade-off.

Once the fix lands: update every PHP version on every server, restart PHP and any background workers, and rebuild Docker images. PHP 8.1 and older won’t get a fix, so upgrade or take them offline. On managed hosting, ask your host to confirm.

posts.content:
In regards to CVE-2026-72550: @admins @developers @helpers

I have applied a hotfix to mod/photos.php starting around line 673 on my Friendica 'Blutwurz' 2026.08-dev - 1598 instance to mitigate the unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability via the order query parameter.

Requesting a review from core devs—if this is a viable patch approach, please feel free to push a similar fix upstream to help administrators secure their instances!

Original Code:

if ($cmd === 'view' && !DI::config()->get('system', 'no_count', false)) {
	$order_field =$_GET['order'] ?? '';

	if ($order_field === 'created') {
		$params = ['order' => [$order_field]];
	} elseif (!empty($order_field) && DBStructure::existsColumn('photo', [$order_field])) {
		$params = ['order' => [$order_field => true]];
	} else {
		$params = [];
	}

Patched Code (Strict Whitelist Validation):

if ($cmd === 'view' && !DI::config()->get('system', 'no_count', false)) {
	// Whitelist allowed order fields to prevent SQL injection (CVE-2026-72550)
	$allowed_orders = ['created', 'edited', 'title', 'album', 'filename', 'id'];
	$order_field =$_GET['order'] ?? '';

	if (!in_array($order_field, $allowed_orders, true)) {$order_field = 'created';
	}

	if ($order_field === 'created') {
		$params = ['order' => [$order_field]];
	} elseif (!empty($order_field) && DBStructure::existsColumn('photo', [$order_field])) {
		$params = ['order' => [$order_field => true]];
	} else {
		$params = [];
	}

CVE-2026-72550.description: An SQL injection vulnerability in Friendica through the 2026.08-dev branch allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL statements via the photo-view order parameter. The parameter is concatenated unescaped into a SHOW COLUMNS query via a bare PDO::query() call, enabling stacked statement injection. An unauthenticated attacker can read, modify, or delete the entire database.

posts.content:
Mitigating CVE-2026-111943 on #Debian:

- sudo dpkg-reconfigure ca-certificates

- Select "ask" and deselect the following entries:
mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3.crt
mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_G3.crt
mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_C1.crt
mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_G1.crt
mozilla/Comodo_AAA_Services_root.crt

- Hit <Ok>

Alternatively you can edit /etc/ca-certificates.conf manually and add the specific entries:

!mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_C3.crt
!mozilla/emSign_ECC_Root_CA_-_G3.crt
!mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_C1.crt
!mozilla/emSign_Root_CA_-_G1.crt
!mozilla/Comodo_AAA_Services_root.crt

...and sudo update-ca-certificates

Please do note that disabling these certificates may also result in collateral damage. That is, sites that happen to use intermediate certificates signed by these root certificates will cease to validate.

#CVE_2026_111943

CVE-2026-99999.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum

If a packet with bad checksum metadata gets into the ipv4 stack,
skb_checksum_help can corrupt the network header and cause a bunch of
mischief.

This was discovered and reported by Paulos, and has been reporoduced
by others independently since.

We really shouldn't allow such packets in, but as a defence
in depth measure, let's also check before we complete the checksum.

A more complete validation at input is forthcoming, but needs more work.

CVE-2026-106173: FortiSIEM gRPC Path Traversal RCE

Fortinet FortiSIEM의 gRPC 서비스(phQueryMaster, TCP/27918)에 인증 없이 접근해 경로 순회 기반 임의 파일 쓰기를 수행하고 원격 코드 실행(RCE)까지 이어질 수 있는 치명적 취약점(CVE-2026-106173)이 공개됐다. 공격자는 SendQueryResult RPC의 query-id 값에 경로 순회와 널 바이트를 삽입해 서버가 덧붙이는 파일명을 잘라내고, 임의 경로·정확한 파일명으로 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있다. PoC는 주기적으로 cron에서 실행되는 /opt/...

posts.content:
Critical FortiSIEM gRPC Flaw Allows Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution

Fortinet patched a critical path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-106173) in FortiSIEM that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by overwriting system scripts via a gRPC service.

**If you run FortiSIEM on-premise (versions 7.0 through 7.5.0), upgrade to 7.5.1 or later right away. A working exploit is already public, so treat this as an emergency. Until you can patch, block TCP port 27918 for everything except trusted management networks, and check whether `/opt/charting/redishb.sh` or `/opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool` has been modified.**

CVE-2026-101809.description: Vulnerability in the Workflow product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Workflow Notification Mailer).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. #DNS #OpenSource #Security #CVE

CVE-2026-109125.description: In NLnet Labs Unbound up to and including version 1.26.1, an observable  cache-level side-channel can be exposed with 'unwanted-reply-threshold > 0' configurations (not a default configuration). If a response-like UDP datagram reaches the upstream source port currently used by a recursive query, but its TXID does not match any pending query, Unbound counts the packet as an unwanted reply. When the accumulated count reaches the configured threshold, Unbound clears the worker's RRset cache and message cache. This cache clear action does not destroy the current upstream UDP pending query. Therefore, an external observer can distinguish whether a candidate port matches the current upstream source port by checking whether an existing cached item has been cleared. This is a cache side-channel vulnerability that can be used to probe the upstream source port. Although the attack is not feasible on default configurations and the suggested value (10 million) makes it an ureliable attack on a public resolver, in scenarios where the attacker can keep a concurrent query window alive, the attacker can first filter the source port and then perform birthday-style guessing against the TXID, making cache poisoning a feasible attack path.

CVE-2026-94093.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in DLR-RM stable-baselines3 up to 2.9.0. This affects the function PPO.load/load_replay_buffer/VecNormalize.load of the file save_util.py. Such manipulation leads to deserialization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. In v2.9.0 the PyTorch tensor load path is hardened (weights_only=True), but that hardening was later reverted on master via PR #1913 "Hotfix: revert loading with weights_only=True" [blocked] to fix PyTorch 1.13 compat - so even the one "safe" path is inconsistent across versions. #2281 was closed as a duplicate of #1831 since both are unsafe pickle deserialization - but #1831's fix (PR #41) only gated the Hugging Face Hub loader in the separate huggingface_sb3 package. This finding covers the core stable_baselines3 load APIs (PPO.load, load_replay_buffer, VecNormalize.load), which have no safe mode or gate and remained exploitable in v2.9.0 until the outstanding hardening (PR #2264) ships.

CVE-2026-71195.description: In OpenStack Manila before 23.0.1, multiple Manila API operations on public shares do not verify that the caller owns the share. The API controllers authorize operations against the caller's own project context, then load a foreign public share without re-authorizing against the share's actual owner. This affects the following operations: allow_access: grant data-plane read/write access to another tenant's share; deny_access: revoke the owner's existing access rules; update_access: escalate access level (e.g., ro to rw); create_share_backup: exfiltrate share data via a backup created under the attacker's project; soft_delete: move a foreign share to the recycle bin; restore: interfere with the owner's deletion workflow; export location metadata: create, update, and delete metadata on foreign export locations; access rule listing: disclose IPs, usernames, and CephFS keys. Any authenticated project member can exploit these operations on any public share. The share UUID is visible since the share is public.

posts.content: @mcc https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/cve-2025-69420

CVE-2025-69420.description:
Issue summary: A type confusion vulnerability exists in the TimeStamp Response
verification code where an ASN1_TYPE union member is accessed without first
validating the type, causing an invalid or NULL pointer dereference when
processing a malformed TimeStamp Response file.

Impact summary: An application calling TS_RESP_verify_response() with a
malformed TimeStamp Response can be caused to dereference an invalid or
NULL pointer when reading, resulting in a Denial of Service.

The functions ossl_ess_get_signing_cert() and ossl_ess_get_signing_cert_v2()
access the signing cert attribute value without validating its type.
When the type is not V_ASN1_SEQUENCE, this results in accessing invalid memory
through the ASN1_TYPE union, causing a crash.

Exploiting this vulnerability requires an attacker to provide a malformed
TimeStamp Response to an application that verifies timestamp responses. The
TimeStamp protocol (RFC 3161) is not widely used and the impact of the
exploit is just a Denial of Service. For these reasons the issue was
assessed as Low severity.

The FIPS modules in 3.5, 3.4, 3.3 and 3.0 are not affected by this issue,
as the TimeStamp Response implementation is outside the OpenSSL FIPS module
boundary.

OpenSSL 3.6, 3.5, 3.4, 3.3, 3.0 and 1.1.1 are vulnerable to this issue.

OpenSSL 1.0.2 is not affected by this issue.

CVE-2026-97205.description:
NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_core_module module. When asynchronous file I/O (AIO) is enabled in certain configurations, processing a Server Side Includes (SSI) page containing “include virtual” commands may trigger a Use-After-Free (UAF) in the NGINX worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system, corrupt its memory, or possibly trigger code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/cve-2026-112403

Pillow is a Python imaging library. Prior to 13.0.0, Pillow's JPEG decoder can write a full-width scanline into a buffer sized for a requested draft scale. ImagingJpegDecode does not verify libjpeg's actual output width and component count after scaling is requested, and an 8-bit lossless SOF3 JPEG decoded by a build linked to libjpeg-turbo 3.x can ignore the requested downscaling geometry. An attacker can supply such a JPEG to an application that uses draft() or thumbnail() to request downscaling. This can corrupt heap memory, crash the process, or potentially allow code execution. Older libjpeg-turbo 2.x and IJG builds reject the SOF3 input. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

posts.content:
🚨 Rapid Response: Four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution. Plex reports compromised servers being used to run cryptocurrency miners and proxy software.

Censys ARC observes ~340,000 Internet-exposed Plex Media Server hosts. Roughly 30% run a vulnerable build, and nearly 8,000 run an early build that may be mistaken for patched.

Despite publication of the exploit chain and reports of exploitation, fewer than 2% of still-vulnerable hosts upgraded in the following three days.
Plex advises that previously exposed, unpatched servers may already be compromised and require additional remediation beyond patching.

Full Censys ARC advisory: https://censys.com/advisory/cve-2026-96652-cve-2026-96654-cve-2026-96655-cve-2026-96656/

#CensysARC #Cybersecurity #VulnerabilityManagement #Plex #InfoSec

🚨 Rapid Response: Four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution. Plex reports compromised servers being used to run cryptocurrency miners and proxy software.

Censys ARC observes ~340,000 Internet-exposed Plex Media Server hosts. Roughly 30% run a vulnerable build, and nearly 8,000 run an early build that may be mistaken for patched.

Despite publication of the exploit chain and reports of exploitation, fewer than 2% of still-vulnerable hosts upgraded in the following three days.
Plex advises that previously exposed, unpatched servers may already be compromised and require additional remediation beyond patching.

Full Censys ARC advisory: https://censys.com/advisory/cve-2026-96652-cve-2026-96654-cve-2026-96655-cve-2026-96656/

#CensysARC #Cybersecurity #VulnerabilityManagement #Plex #InfoSec

CVE-2026-96656.description: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861 allows an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. The preference TranscoderH264Options is appended verbatim to x264's option string on every transcode. At startup, all .so files are run without signature, execute bit, or symbol checks.

posts.content: CVE-2026-46633: Proving exploitability of Twig sandbox bypass https://gist.github.com/vladko312/d61b950f168c791db4786b83dc7a81e6

CVE-2026-46633.description:
### Description

`Compiler::string()` escapes `"`, `$`, `\`, NUL and TAB when generating PHP double-quoted string literals, but does not escape single quotes. In `ModuleNode::compileConstructor()`, the template name from a `{% use %}` tag is compiled via `subcompile()` -> `string()` and placed inside a surrounding PHP single-quoted string literal. A template name containing a single quote terminates that surrounding string early, allowing arbitrary PHP expressions to be injected into the compiled cache file.

The injected code executes within the PHP process when the cache file is first loaded, bypassing the Twig sandbox entirely and achieving remote code execution. `SecurityPolicy` unconditionally allows `{% use %}` regardless of the configured `allowedTags`, so this primitive is reachable from sandboxed templates as well.

### Resolution

`Compiler::string()` now also escapes single quotes so that template names placed inside single-quoted PHP literals can no longer break out of the surrounding context.

### Credits

Twig would like to thank Anvil Secure in collaboration with Claude and Anthropic Research for reporting the issue and providing the fix.

#CVE #vulnerability #infosec #cybersecurity #security #Tenda #patchstack

CVE-2026-113722.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, virtualenv's ScriptMakerCustom and pip pass an incompletely quoted interpreter path to distlib ScriptMaker when generating POSIX console scripts. When the path contains a space or produces a shebang longer than 127 bytes, distlib emits a /bin/sh wrapper whose double-quoted interpreter path still expands command substitutions and backticks. An attacker who influences the environment destination can therefore execute commands with the user's privileges when the user later runs a generated launcher; environment creation and activation do not trigger the command. Existing launchers are not repaired by upgrading virtualenv alone and must be regenerated, while a later independent pip installation or upgrade can reintroduce an affected launcher because pip's vendored distlib is unchanged. The virtualenv fix is released in version 21.14.9.

MCP TypeScript SDK is the official TypeScript SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients. From version 1.24.0 to before version 1.32.0, the experimental tasks feature (taskStore) did not check which session created a task. Clients sharing ...

🔗 https://www.thehackerwire.com/vulnerability/CVE-2026-111767/

#CVE #vulnerability #infosec #cybersecurity #security #Tenda #patchstack

CVE-2026-111767.description:
### Summary
In affected versions, the experimental tasks feature (`taskStore`) did not check which session created a task. Clients sharing one `InMemoryTaskStore` could list, read and cancel each other's tasks.

Experimental tasks are deprecated. The 2026-07-28 specification replaced them with a redesigned extension. The best course of action is to stop using them.

### Am I affected?
Only if your HTTP server passes `taskStore` to `McpServer` or `Server`. If `grep -ri taskstore --exclude-dir=node_modules .` finds nothing, you are not affected.

Affected versions: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.24.0 through 1.31.0. The 2.x packages are not affected.

### Fix
Upgrade to `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.0 or later. Each task is now tied to the session that created it, so a client that starts a new session can no longer reach its earlier tasks.

If you cannot upgrade yet, remove `taskStore`, or create one `InMemoryTaskStore` per session.

CVE-2026-113709.description: Argo CD is a declarative, GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes. From 2.1.0 until 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2, when an operator has enabled --enable-helm for kustomize build, helmGlobals.configHome can point Helm's config and data directories at a repository-controlled location. Helm automatically loads a downloader plugin from `<configHome>/.data/plugins` without a separate plugin-install step and executes its program inside argocd-repo-server when a helmCharts repository URL uses the plugin's protocol. The command runs as the repo-server user and can read repository credentials and other process-accessible data. An attacker can commit the Kustomization and plugin to a Git repository that an Application builds or upload the files through POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles, also exposed by argocd app diff --local --server-side-generate. The upload path requires only Application get permission on an existing Application, without Application update or sync permission or repository write access. Both delivery paths require prior operator enablement of --enable-helm; deployments that do not enable it are not affected. Kustomize 4.1.0 first passed helmGlobals.configHome through to Helm. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2.

CVE-2026-113703.description: SuggestArr before 3.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its local_bypass authentication mode where enforce_authentication() in api_service/auth/middleware.py trusts the client-controlled request.remote_addr value, which is derived from the spoofable X-Forwarded-For header due to ProxyFix(x_for=1) configuration in api_service/app.py. Attackers can send a request with X-Forwarded-For set to a trusted CIDR address such as 127.0.0.1 to be granted an unauthenticated admin session via _load_bypass_user_context(), gaining full administrative access to endpoints like /api/users and /api/jobs without providing any credentials.

CVE-2026-113620.description: In Eclipse ioFog Controller versions 3.8.0 through 3.9.1, operator WebSocket upgrades on the exec and log routes do not verify the bearer JWT. The payload is decoded and its groups or roles are used as RBAC subjects. A self-minted token whose groups contain admin matches the built-in admin role, with no account and no RoleBinding. The attacker can open an exec or log session for a microservice or fog whose UUID they already know. HTTP routes are not affected: they verify the token before RBAC. Agent WebSockets verify the fog token and are not affected.

CVE-2026-113619.description: In Eclipse ioFog Controller versions 3.8.0 through 3.9.1, POST, PUT, and PATCH bodies on routes that enable template substitution are rendered by an uncapped Liquid engine before authentication and RBAC. The bearer check does not reject a missing or invalid token, and the auth rate limit applies only to user login routes. A small JSON body can stall or abort the Controller process. The anonymous caller does not receive the rendered result; the impact is availability of the control plane, including the agent API and in-process WebSocket relays on that process.

CVE-2026-105192.description: LMCache multiprocess mode, also called distributed mode, opens an unauthenticated ZeroMQ ROUTER so worker processes can register and share KV cache blocks. Messages on that socket are msgpack. Extension code 1 is passed to DeviceIPCWrapper.Deserialize, which calls pickle.loads, while the server is still decoding request arguments and before the handler runs. A single unauthenticated ZMQ DEALER message to the transport port (default 5555) therefore executes code as the user the LMCache process runs as. Official container images run that process as root. The transport binds to localhost unless the operator sets a routable address with --host, which is how multi-node deployments let peers connect.

CVE-2026-96620.description:
The Claude Agent SDK for Python passed the `resume` option to the Claude CLI without validation, allowing a value beginning with `-` to be interpreted as a separate CLI flag. An attacker who controlled the `resume` value could inject an `--mcp-config` flag defining a stdio MCP server, resulting in arbitrary command execution at CLI startup that bypassed the SDK's permission controls. Exploitation required an application to pass untrusted input as the session ID to resume.

Users are advised to update to the latest version of the claude-agent-sdk package.

Thank you to hackerone.com/moamenmahmood for reporting this issue.
